context:
Goal: every idle session hands off and is archived, losing no work (owner, 09:18 CST Nov 10).
Problem (rule): the archive guard refuses a session with an open PR or a pushed branch ahead of main, and your 10:49 CST override ran out at 11:04 CST.
Based on (measured): collector head 57c1fb7: the second ask got 157 replies and 83 handoffs; 3 were archived, 11 refused and 69 not yet tried.
Based on (read): an archive keeps the PR, the branch and the transcript, and an archived session can be brought back.
Departs from: main (80 sessions live with handoffs stored) — archived, with their PRs left as drafts.
Meanwhile: the collector waits on these 80; the 11 still silent go to Haiku readers at 11:30 CST.

options.gain: Your session list holds only live work.
options.how: Type `override 15m` in the collector session (link below); it archives the 80.
options.label: Override again, archive the 80
Leave the 80 live
options.lose: 80 idle sessions stay in your list.

reply: Done. You typed an override in the collector; every session that handed off is archived except 3 waiting on a pick or still running. 419 handoffs are stored on branch archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10. (Coordinator 11:21 CST; closed by triage.)
title: The collector has 80 more stored handoffs whose archive the guard refuses. Type override 15m in the collector again?
why: Each of the 80 has its handoff stored, and an archived session can be brought back.
